what_it_does.name: hf-cli
what_it_does.summary: A single SKILL.md, generated with huggingface_hub v2.4.0, that lists the commands and options of the Hugging Face Hub CLI hf. It covers downloading and uploading files, managing repos, buckets, collections, discussions and pull requests, browsing models, datasets, spaces and papers, querying datasets with SQL, running jobs and sandboxes on Hugging Face infrastructure, and deploying Inference Endpoints. Results are files on disk, changes on the Hub, and command output in auto, human, agent, json or quiet format. Use it whenever the user mentions hf, huggingface or Hugging Face, or wants to do anything in the Hugging Face ecosystem.
tasks: download, upload, copy and sync files between local paths, repos and buckets
manage repos, branches, tags, collections, discussions and pull requests on the Hub
browse and search models, datasets, spaces and papers, and query datasets with DuckDB SQL
run and schedule Jobs and sandboxes on Hugging Face infrastructure
deploy and manage Inference Endpoints and configure Spaces
manage authentication, the local cache, webhooks, extensions and skills

risks.risk: Instructions hidden in outsider-authored discussions, pull requests, model cards, dataset info or papers reach the agent when it reads them through hf.
risks.severity: MEDIUM by C1, SAFE overall by C2

risks.risk: The install command pipes a script fetched from hf.co straight into bash, so whatever that script contains runs on the machine.
hf auth token prints the current access token to stdout, where it enters the agent's context and terminal logs.
hf extensions install downloads third-party code from public GitHub repositories, which then runs through hf extensions exec.
hf jobs run, hf jobs uv run and hf sandbox exec execute arbitrary code on Hugging Face infrastructure under the user's account.
A repo removed with hf repos delete is lost, since the operation is irreversible.
Jobs, sandboxes and Inference Endpoints started on GPU flavors such as a100x8 or h200x8 keep incurring charges until they are cancelled, paused or deleted.
risks.mitigation: none stated, --timeout and --scale-to-zero-timeout exist as options

risks.risk: An access token passed with --token stays in shell history or logs.
risks.mitigation: the files recommend setting HF_TOKEN instead of passing --token

limitations: Secret values of a Space are write-only and are not returned by hf spaces secrets list.
Sandboxes on Hugging Face Jobs are experimental.
A repo mounted with hf-mount is read-only, a bucket is read-write.
The command list reflects huggingface_hub v2.4.0, full options and examples come from hf <command> --help.

known_problems.workaround: use hf, with auth commands under hf auth
